[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Nikko include:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Suginamiki: Known for soba and tempura. (Tel: +81-288-53-2201)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Yuzuan: Family-run restaurant serving seasonal kaiseki meals. (Tel: +81-288-53-2828)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Kanaya Honten: Historic restaurant serving traditional Japanese cuisine since 1666. (Tel: +81-288-53-3161)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Tsuruya: Offers traditional dishes near Toshogu Shrine. (Tel: +81-288-53-2111)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reservations are highly recommended for these restaurants.
